name: Fist / Kick
desc: Bare unarmed strike. The DC-4 anchor is an *inhuman* fist; an ordinary person lands about 2. Unarmed Combat skill does the rest.

name: Knife / Dagger
desc: Short blade — concealable, pierces armor, doubles as a tool and a thrown weapon. The floor of every weapon list.

name: Sword
desc: The arming sword — one-handed cut-and-thrust. *Fine*, *great*, and *short* are all adjectives on this one noun.

name: Greatsword
desc: Two-handed blade. More reach and bite; no hand free for a shield.

name: Spear
desc: Reach weapon that pierces. Set against a charge it counts double. A *thrown* spear is the same noun, one adjective.

name: Axe
desc: Heavy chopping edge — hits hard, harder to recover for a parry than a sword.

name: Mace / Club
desc: Impact rather than edge — cheap, and it doesn't care how good your armor's edge-turning is.

name: Quarterstaff
desc: Two-handed staff: reach, a good Parry PM, and it's just a stick when the guards ask.

name: Bow
desc: Half-skill ranged weapon (Archery). Quiet, pierces, and only as good as the archer — the mundane benchmark magic is judged against.

name: Crossbow
desc: Point-and-hold power — trivial to aim, slow to span. Punches armor a bow can't.

name: Revolver
desc: Reliable double-action sidearm; six shots, slow to reload. *Cut-down* makes it a concealable snub-nose.

name: Pistol (9mm)
desc: The DC-8 anchor. Self-loading, high-capacity magazine — the default modern handgun.

name: Submachine Gun
desc: Pistol round, automatic fire. Devastating up close, thirsty and wild at range.

name: Shotgun
desc: Brutal and forgiving up close; falls off fast. *Cut-down* trades the last of its range for concealment.

name: Assault Rifle
desc: Intermediate cartridge, select fire — the standard modern long arm. *Carbine* is the light adjective.

name: Battle Rifle (7.62)
desc: The DC-11 anchor. Full-power rifle round: range and penetration at the cost of weight and recoil.

name: Sniper Rifle
desc: Precision, optics, and armor-piercing reach. A patient specialist's tool, not a firefight weapon.

name: Machine Gun
desc: Belt-fed area denial — see Fire Combat. Emplaced or bipod; suppresses ground you never actually hit.

name: Hand Grenade
desc: Blast in a radius — no aim roll against a point, a scatter roll against an area. Fragmentation ignores light cover.

name: Laspistol
desc: Energy sidearm: no recoil, no ballistic drop, a power cell instead of a magazine. The SF echo of the 9mm.

name: Laser Rifle
desc: Line-of-sight beam weapon — flat trajectory, hungry for cells, dimmed by smoke and fog.

name: Stun Pistol
desc: Non-lethal takedown — damage feeds a Pain Resistance / stun check rather than a wound. Short-ranged by design.

name: Cone Rifle
desc: Fires micro-rockets — recoilless, heavy hitting, and it arcs, so cover is less help than you'd hope.

name: Autolasercannon
desc: Vehicle- or emplacement-scale beam weapon. Uses the Damage Scale rules — meant for things bigger than people.
